content.text: The build passed, and the report marks `/speakers` as partial prerender, so the speaker list streams from the server on each request and never at build time. I added two files: `app/speakers/page.tsx` renders the heading, the Back button, and a Suspense boundary around an async list that calls `connection()` and then reads `/speakers` from the JSON API through the existing `read` helper in `lib/db.ts`. The second file, `app/speakers/back-button.tsx`, is a small Client Component that uses `useRouter` from `next/navigation` and pushes to `/` on click, so only the button ships client JavaScript. I did not use the cached `getSpeaker` helper or any segment configuration, because caching contradicts the per-request requirement and segment configuration errors under the cacheComponents flag in this project. To see it in the browser, start `npm run dev` so json-server is up on port 3001 and open `/speakers`.
